notes.title: Unleashing Bloodmoon: Meet the Mistress of Shadows!
notes.content:
[h1] The Mistress of Shadows Awakens – A New Threat Rises in Bloodmoon[/h1]

The cursed lands of [i]Bloodmoon[/i] grow even darker as an ancient horror emerges from the abyss. She is veiled in beauty, yet drenched in malice—a predator of the night whose whispers can ensnare even the strongest of wills. Beware, for the Vampire Queen has awakened.  

[h2]A Sovereign of Blood and Darkness[/h2]

Once a ruler of mortals, now an eternal queen of the damned, she feeds on the lifeblood of the living, her hunger insatiable. Few who meet her gaze live to tell the tale, and those who do… are never the same again.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45299834/163f3b5bdbfe7986fee7f995cbdedba5c653dd67.png[/img]

[h2]Gameplay Insight: Face the Vampire Queen[/h2]

Lethal Grace – Unlike the shambling Forsaken Dead, the Vampire Queen is swift, deadly, and immune to lightning.
  
She is not just another enemy—she is the predator, and you are the prey.  

[h2]Will You Survive the Night?[/h2]

Only the most prepared warriors will stand a chance. Stock up on holy relics, sharpen your blades, and be ready to fight for your soul.  

📜 Add Bloodmoon to your Steam Wishlist to stay updated!  
💀 Join our Discord and share your strategies with fellow hunters.  

The darkness is spreading… Are you strong enough to face what lurks within?
